title: The restored scale
note: Al-Khwarizmi turned a balance scale into a general method, and gave algebra its name.

research.quotes: heroes.html#f-mathematics: 'In Baghdad, in the young House of Wisdom, a scholar from Khwarazm wrote a book with a modest purpose.' 'He called his method al-jabr, the restoration, the setting of a broken thing back in its place: move what is subtracted across an equation and balance is restored.' 'He stepped back from particular puzzles and taught the general method, a way of solving every problem of a given shape rather than one problem at a time.' 'Latin scribes rendered al-Khwarizmi as Algoritmi, and algorithm slowly came to mean any clear, step by step procedure that anyone can follow and check.' Person meta line: 'Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi, about 780 to 850 · Baghdad.'
research.retell: Al-Khwarizmi showed that any equation can be solved by doing the same thing to both sides of a scale until only the unknown is left, and that trick became algebra.

lines.text: One trick can solve any equation
Baghdad, Iraq, the young House of Wisdom
One pan holds an unknown, plus five
The other pan holds twelve alone
He takes five away from each side
What remains: the unknown equals seven
Before him, each puzzle needed its own fix
lines.sub: he taught one method for every shape

lines.text: Every "solve for x" still uses his rule
He called it al-jabr, the restoration
